provenance.source: frozen blind prediction v1 of 'iecd_ref_p' (configuration 'iecd_ref'), Monte Carlo envelope of 200 Latin-hypercube runs (seed 20260925) over the tolerances of: driver_Re_ohm, driver_Mms_g, driver_Sd_cm2, driver_compliance_factor, driver_Bl_factor, driver_Rms_factor, driver_rear_boss_diameter_mm, diaphragm_setback_mm, lip_inner_diameter_mm, lip_thickness_mm, driver_gasket_mm, cup_inner_diameter_mm, pad_ring_width_mm, pad_ring_height_mm, gasket_compressed_mm, rear_depth_mm, back_plate_mm, rear_mesh_hole_diameter_mm, front_hole_diameter_mm, mesh_rayl, residual_leak_gap_mm; protocol 'Open reference cup: measurement session (spec Section 17)'

notes: Columns: frequency_Hz; nominal, median, p5, p10, p90, p95, min, max in dB; runs (successful Monte Carlo runs); shading (validity of the nominal solve: 0 none, 1 light, 2 dark; docs/netlist.md). Percentiles: linear interpolation between order statistics (numpy default). Damped IEC 60318-4 variant on a flat plate, reference state. Overrides: {"drive_mW":0.01,"fidelity":1,"front_plug":"mesh","load":"iec60318_4_damped","rear_plug":"mesh","residual_leak_gap_mm":0.01,"source_impedance_ohm":0}. A damped IEC 60318-4 simulator (for example GRAS RA0401/RA0402, which the manufacturer states complies with IEC 60318-4 from 100 Hz to 10 kHz with the 13.5 kHz resonance damped). The engine has no model of the damping: the prediction is the undamped model, frozen and compared up to 10 kHz only.
